source: ClassPad.net Math - exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-20 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
notes: 23 native PLUS observations, 2026-11-20, saved through the local project writer. Full 192×63 LCD body and visible status icons are compared; no mask or expected-value substitution.
Implicit multiplication binds before explicit division: 2Not(0)=-2, 2Neg(3)=-6, 8÷2Not(1)=-2, 8÷2(1+1)=2. Typed h2 follows the same rule.
After successful evaluation the implicit divisor is stored with editable parentheses. LEFT and DEL remove the added closing parenthesis; reevaluation closes it again.
Base-N wraps at seventeen 11-pixel cells below its header. A full line places the caret on the next line, and the result follows that line.

Neg(h80000000) overflows. AC preserves the failing argument caret; inserting Not(h80000000) there creates a nested implicit product which also overflows. The full wrapped edit and AC return are observed independently.
